messages.subject: Updating post/pre characters on sliderInput
parts:
I am currently working on an application w/ various sliders where the units are currency.  In order to maintain context for the user, currency symbols are used for the prefix and postfix on the slider label.  However, if the user changes the currency, I cannot (AFAIK) update the sliders using updateSliderInput because this does not take an argument for the pre/postfix.

My current solution is to render all the sliders in server.r using renderUI, but this seems like a much slower and clunkier solution than is necessary.

Is there a clean and efficient way to update the pre/postfix on slider labels rather than rendering an entirely new slider using renderUI?
